headline: Junior QA Engineer | Manual & Automation Testing
summary: Meticulous Junior QA Engineer with over a year of experience in ensuring software quality through both manual and automated testing methodologies. Skilled in the full software testing life cycle (STLC), defect tracking, and API validation. Proven track record at leading Nepali fintech firms like Khalti and F1Soft International in identifying critical bugs and improving system stability.

experiences.title: Junior QA Engineer
description: Developed and executed automated test scripts using Selenium WebDriver and Java for the Khalti web dashboard.
Perform comprehensive API testing using Postman to ensure seamless integration of payment gateways.
Collaborate with the cross-functional agile team to review requirements and define acceptance criteria.
Conduct regression and smoke testing for bi-weekly mobile app releases on Android and iOS platforms.
Utilize JIRA for bug tracking, reporting, and monitoring the defect life cycle.

experiences.title: QA Intern
description: Assisted senior QA engineers in manual testing of various mobile banking applications.
Drafted over 200+ detailed test cases and test scenarios based on functional requirement documents.
Identified, documented, and prioritized UI/UX inconsistencies and functional bugs.
Participated in daily stand-up meetings and contributed to sprint planning sessions.
Gained hands-on experience with SQL for verifying data integrity in backend databases.

experiences.title: Final Year Project: E-commerce Automation Framework
description: Designed and implemented a modular automation testing framework using Selenium, TestNG, and Maven.
Applied Page Object Model (POM) design pattern to enhance script maintainability and readability.
Generated detailed Extent Reports for automated test execution results.
Simulated real-world user workflows including product search, cart management, and checkout processes.
